items.mainDefect: Adding an existing member attempts a duplicate membership insert and raises an unhandled database uniqueness error.

secondary.defect: The username selector is never cleared after adding members, making repeat submissions easy.
The client-side addMembers action lacks an error handler, so failed requests are silent.

items.mainDefect: Removing membership without destroying the join record can bypass counter-cache bookkeeping and leave group.user_count stale.

secondary.defect: Removing a member does not clear primary_group_id when it points to the removed group.

items.mainDefect: The membership controller specs pass group_id instead of the route's id parameter, masking the parameter mismatch.

secondary.defect: The membership controller actions require group_id even though member routes provide id, causing real requests to fail with HTTP 400.

items.mainDefect: The membership controller actions require group_id even though member routes provide id, causing real requests to fail with HTTP 400.

secondary.defect: The frontend does not handle membership AJAX promise rejections, so request failures are silent.
